text_block_list.text:
The public is astonished by the runaway
style
Сайленс Судзука employs during her
debut race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув cautions her of the
difficulties that lie
ahead, and warns me
not to waste Silence
Suzuka's talent.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I take the warning to heart, firmly
determined to
become a pillar of
support for Сайленс Судзука.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
